Reviewed the full R1-R14 diff. Added 2 generic guards. 802 tests pass.

Verified R1-R14 and all 6 acceptance criteria empirically. All PASS. 802/802 tests green, all 615 baseline tests confirmed present by name-diff vs clean HEAD checkout. Fixed 2 stale v0.5.0 version strings in README. One non-blocking pre-existing risk flagged: untracked .claude/worktrees/ would be staged by git add -A.
